presets.title: TRUMPF TruBend 7036 (36 t)
sources: TruBend 7036: 360 kN press force, 1020 mm bending length (consistent across machine listings)
Air-bending force rule 60 t^2 L / V tonnes with V = 8 t; material factors stainless about 1.5, aluminum about 0.55 (press brake tonnage charts)

Limits plus the inside radius R the tooling forms (t by default, so the same as 3 t / 4 t then): flange 2 t + R error, 3 t + R warning (services publish 3 t to 4 t); feature distance 2 t + R and relief depth t + R as warnings only (services publish 2.5 t + R or warn of deformed geometry near bends rather than refusing; corpus parts were made with features 1.3 t and reliefs 0.65 t from bends); designs drawn below 0.25 t inside radius fail (corpus: parts made at 0.33 t, refused at 0.17 t and tighter)
presets.notes: Listing data, consistent across sources. Maximum thickness per material (6.35 mm) is a conservative assumption, not maker data; the force check is the real limit for long bends. 6061 aluminum is left out: it cracks when bent.
